extracted text: The paper investigates laser peening without coating (LPwC) on aluminum alloy Al-6061-T6 using a low energy (300mJ) Nd:YAG laser. The sample dimensions were 4 cm × 4 cm × 4 mm prepared from 30 mm thick Al-6061-T6 sheet by electric discharge machining (EDM) wire cutting. After LPwC treatment, the micro-hardness showed a maximum improvement of 10 HV near the surface compared to the unpeened material. The hardened layer was observed up to 0.7 mm from the surface.
